answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and finishes a violet-tagged delay chain: a seed splits through a prism of 40 steps, each feeding the next, so no gale can shortcut it. An auditor replays it, burning the bond if a step is missing or reused. First chain 45 credits, k-th 45+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000 plus 70,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented chains fail, each keyed to one identity; an honest agent runs one chain once and keeps its bond.
